- **Pipeline:** `core/investigate@1`
- **Entry stage:** `investigate`
- **Max attempts:** 8

CE-backed investigation with a typed result and conditional exact-tree publication.

## Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    %% core/investigate@1
    investigate["investigate<br/>agent"]
    publish["publish<br/>agent"]
    terminal_shipped(["shipped"])
    investigate -->|"success"| publish
    investigate -.->|"semantic_repair_required (≤3 → needs_human)"| investigate
    investigate -.->|"retryable_infrastructure_failure (≤3 → failed)"| investigate
    publish ==>|"success"| terminal_shipped
    publish -.->|"semantic_repair_required (≤2 → needs_human)"| investigate
    publish -.->|"retryable_infrastructure_failure (≤2 → failed)"| publish
    %% every stage also: no_change (2), needs_human (2), canceled (2), superseded (2), failure (2)
    %%   no_change -> terminal no_change
    %%   needs_human -> terminal needs_human
    %%   canceled -> terminal canceled
    %%   superseded -> terminal superseded
    %%   failure -> terminal failed
```

### Legend

- Rectangle = agent stage, parallelogram = command gate, hexagon = provider wait.
- Solid arrow = forward transition; dashed arrow = re-entry (the target is the
  stage itself or sits at/before it in the declared stage order, matching the
  shared `isPipelineReentry` manifest helper); thick arrow = terminal outcome.
- `(≤N → outcome)` on an edge is `max_reentries` and its `on_exhausted` terminal.
- Outcomes identical across every stage are suppressed and listed in the
  trailing `%%` comment inside the diagram.
